I was walking out of Walgreens and was approached by two men allegedly raising money for a suicide victim's assistance charity. There are often people fundraising in our neighborhood. They told me that the money was to help pay for the funeral of the younger man's brother. I said I'd donate $15. The younger man told me he had to log into an IL state portal on my phone to show me something and the other one took my Discover card first and charged it twice for $500, but told me it didn't go through, and then asked me for my other card, which he then charged four times for $500. I have disputed these charges with the bank. I think that the younger one wanted my phone to try to authorize the charges/make sure they went through.

I recieved a text message from (717) 930-4755 saying: "Your health policy has an unresolved past-due balance. Failure to resolve this will result in termination and loss of benefits. Call 888-756-1846 immediately." I'm currently on Medicaid and don't have any past-due balance, but I decided to call the number to get to the bottom of this. After waiting a few seconds, I was connected with an individual on the other line asking me why I was calling. I told them my name and explained the text message, and said that I had no past-due balance. The individual then asked if I had a health policy through an employer or a personal plan. I proceeded to say that I was on Medicaid (I didn't say my plan or any sensitive information, just that I was on Medicaid). Immediately after I mentioned Medicaid, they abruptly hung up.

I said there is nothing to discuss I do not want the service and I want my money back. The next day same thing except He would talk to the billing department. Over a week now no call back. I have called daily getting the same answering machine message they are away from my desk right now but will return your call. It is wrong to take money out of anyone's account without notifying them first. Shawn stated it is in the contract autorenewal. Even then I should have been notified 1st. This is just plain theft.
